text:
maria: FYI alert from billing this morning: duplicated token charges correlated with reconnect storms. looks like the new reconnect ordering in the canary released leases a bit early. :confused:
deepak: do we have an example trace?
owen: grabbed one from staging. sequence is: client sends resume -> proxy releases lease -> client reconnects and gets new session id -> billing counts both sessions.
maria: sanitized log:```
2025-03-12T09:03:20Z session=X9 lease=active ttl=90
2025-03-12T09:03:44Z session=X9 lease=release reason=grace_expiry heuristic=v2
2025-03-12T09:03:44.120Z proxy=edge-12 reconnect token=X9 resumed=false billed=true
```
sasha: that 120ms window is the culprit. the canary attempted to reduce stuck leases under heavy fanout by releasing earlier. unfortunately clients that retry quickly cause double-billing.
deepak: current code flow clears the resume token on release to avoid orphan resume slots. new canary flips order to release sooner. so it's consistent with design but has side effects.
maria: immediate options: 1) quick revert of ordering in canary, 2) add a short grace buffer (e.g., 250ms) before actual release, 3) implement billing-side dedupe by resume token.
owen: billing dedupe sounds robust but touches accounting pipeline and could be tricky for long-lived retries. buffer looks low-risk and fast. revert is safest for now.
sasha: can we add a temporary metric: `lease_release_then_reconnect_count` and a console heatmap for affected routes? triage is hard without route-level traces.
qa-bot: flaky-reconnect trial scheduled in staging at 11:00 for 20m :white_check_mark: test job: flaky-resume-loop
deploy-bot: canary rollout status: v2-reconnect-order @ 15% since 08:50Z; alert lease_release_anomaly firing 4m ago
deepak: propose plan: roll back ordering on canary, add metric + dashboard tile, run flaky job, then design proper fix (either controlled gracehold or billing dedupe).
maria: agree. who picks the follow-up? tagging @deepak for design on resume-token lifetime and @owen for Console tile.
owen: will add Console tile: "recent resume-reconnect pairs" with quick link to traces. put it on the top of the streaming route page.
deepak: implementation note: changing order is small: `on_reconnect: try_accept(); if success -> release_lease(); else -> release_lease();` becomes `try_accept(); defer release until accept confirmed`. need tests for race with shard-migration path.
sasha: please also add an alert annotation so paging explains duplicate billing vs actual token misuse. engineers are paged without context.
maria: rollback started at 09:15Z for canary cohort. monitoring owners, watch for the dup-billing metric dropping.
qa-bot: staging run started at 11:00Z and produced 0 duplicates in 20m on v1 ordering :white_check_mark:
deepak: after rollback and staging test, let's plan a short RFC for resume idempotency in billing vs lease-grace tradeoffs. I'll create ticket and invite accounting and infra.
maria: thanks all. leaving thread open until we confirm prod stabilizes (watch console tile).
